Jamie (design): Quick check — attached sketch for the compact timeline. Rollback CTA is tucked into the kebab when screen width < 720px, was wondering about discoverability. https://figma.redwood/s/compact-rollback.png
Noah (product): We get tickets where folks can't find rollback during incidents. Can we surface a context-primary when a canary is > 10% or when anomaly flag is on?
Sasha (eng): We can. Implementation-wise we can flip a UI flag from the runtime signal. Need to gate with a confirm modal to avoid accidental reverts. Also watch focus order when button appears/disappears.
Lee (a11y): Floating/changing primary actions are rough for screen reader users. Recommend always rendering the button in DOM but visually collapse it (aria-hidden toggled) so SRs get consistent structure. Also prefer longer accessible name: "Pause traffic and revert to previous version" instead of just "Rollback".
Aria (design): Two copy options I mocked: 1) Short label for compact: "Pause & Revert" with tooltip "Pause rollout and revert to last stable". 2) Verbose for modal: "Pause traffic and revert to version vX". Tooltip keeps layout tidy.
Jamie (design): Iconography question: should rollback use danger red? Pause/stop is less severe than a full revert. Maybe split: primary is "Pause" (neutral), secondary is "Revert" (danger) in expanded view. On narrow, consolidate to a single action with confirm.
Sasha (eng): Dropdown vs split buttons: dropdown is easier for responsive and avoids layout thrash. Also: we need analytics event 'rollback_intent' and 'rollback_confirmed' for postmortems. I'll add telemetry hooks.
Noah (product): UX requirement: show which version will be restored in the confirmation modal (version tag + small diff link). Users need to know state before committing.
Lee (a11y): Modal copy for SR: one concise sentence at top, e.g. "You are about to revert rollout to version v12. This will stop the current rollout and route 100% to v12." Then a bullet list of consequences. Ensure focus trap, visible focus indicator, and screenreader alert on open.
DeployBot: DeployBot: Canary health check failing on rollout #2149 — auto-pause applied :warning: (see /incidents/2149)
Jamie (design): In that case, let's add a small inline microcopy in the timeline item when auto-pause happens: "Auto-paused due to anomalies — review and revert or resume" with a link to runbook. Makes CTA discovery contextual.
Aria (design): I'll update the Figma: compact view shows a persistent tiny button with icon + tooltip; expanded shows Pause | Revert (danger). Also prototyped double-step keyboard shortcut: press 'r' then 'r' within 2s to open confirm.
Sasha (eng): Double-key confirm is doable but ensure we don't collide with other shortcuts (search, reply). We'll add a global shortcut doc and telemetry for accidental presses.
Noah (product): Sounds good. Can we get mocks and a11y notes in the PR by EOD? Schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to finalize wording. Thanks all :thumbsup:
